passages.text: “You are to construct the tabernacle itself with ten curtains of finely spun linen, each with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and cherubim skillfully worked into them.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
The tabernacle must have ten curtains.
Use finely spun linen for the curtains.
Add blue yarn to the curtains.
Add purple yarn to the curtains.
Add scarlet yarn to the curtains.
Skillful workers must make cherubim designs on the curtains.
Each curtain must have these materials and designs.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֥ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide —all curtains the same size.
passages.sermon: Each curtain must be twenty-eight cubits long.\r\nEach curtain must be four cubits wide.\r\nAll the curtains must be the same size.
passages.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־ הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃

passages.text: Five of the curtains are to be joined together, and the other five joined as well.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
The tabernacle would have ten curtains.
Each curtain would be made of fine linen.
Each curtain would have blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
Each curtain would have cherubim skillfully worked into it.
Each curtain would be the same size.
Each curtain would be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.
God said to join five curtains together.
God said to join the other five curtains together.
There would be two sets of five joined curtains.
passages.original: חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶ֙יןָ֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֑הּ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חֹֽבְרֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Make loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and do the same for the end curtain in the second set.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle had curtains.
Each curtain had a specific design.
Make loops from blue material.
Place these loops on the edge of the last curtain in the first set.
Make the same loops on the edge of the last curtain in the second set.
These loops help join the two sets of curtains together.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וְכֵ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: Make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set, so that the loops line up opposite one another.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy tent for worship.
Make fifty loops on one curtain.
Make fifty loops on the end curtain of the second set.
Place the loops so they line up opposite each other.
passages.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Make fifty gold clasps as well, and join the curtains together with the clasps, so that the tabernacle will be a unit.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy tent for worship.
Make fifty clasps from gold.
Use the gold clasps to join the curtains together.
Connect each curtain to its neighbor with the clasps.
This will make the tabernacle one whole unit.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וְחִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַיְרִיעֹ֜ת אִשָּׁ֤ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָהּ֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃פ

passages.text: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a special tent for worship.
You must make curtains from goat hair.
These curtains will cover the tent over the tabernacle.
You must make eleven curtains in total.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Each of the eleven curtains is to be the same size—thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
There are eleven curtains for the tent over the tabernacle.
Each curtain must be the same size.
Each curtain must be thirty cubits long.
Each curtain must be four cubits wide.
passages.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃

passages.text: Join five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another. Then fold the sixth curtain over double at the front of the tent.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for making the tent over the tabernacle.
The tent used curtains made from goat hair.
There were eleven curtains in total.
Join five curtains together to make one set.
Join the other six curtains together to make a second set.
Take the sixth curtain from the second set.
Fold this sixth curtain over at the front of the tent.
passages.original: וְחִבַּרְתָּ֞ אֶת־ חֲמֵ֤שׁ הַיְרִיעֹת֙ לְבָ֔ד וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְכָפַלְתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔ית אֶל־ מ֖וּל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃

passages.text: Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set, and fifty loops along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the tabernacle.
The tabernacle had two sets of curtains.
Each set of curtains had an end curtain.
Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set.
Make fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the second set.
Place the loops on the edges of the curtains.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּחֹבָ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻֽלָאֹ֗ת עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: Make fifty bronze clasps and put them through the loops to join the tent together as a unit.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a special tent for worship.
Make fifty clasps.
Use bronze to make the clasps.
Put the clasps through the loops on the curtains.
Join the tent together with the clasps.
The tent will become one unit.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֤ אֶת־ הַקְּרָסִים֙ בַּלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת וְחִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל וְהָיָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: As for the overlap that remains of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over shall hang down over the back of the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a holy tent for worship.
The tent has curtains.
Some curtain fabric will be left over after covering the tent.
This leftover part is called the overlap.
Half of the leftover curtain will remain.
This half curtain will hang down.
It will hang over the back of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְסֶ֙רַח֙ הָעֹדֵ֔ף בִּירִיעֹ֖ת הָאֹ֑הֶל חֲצִ֤י הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָעֹדֶ֔פֶת תִּסְרַ֕ח עַ֖ל אֲחֹרֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: And the tent curtains will be a cubit longer on either side, and the excess will hang over the sides of the tabernacle to cover it.
passages.sermon:
The tent curtains are longer than needed for the tabernacle.
Each side of the curtains is one cubit longer than the tabernacle.
The extra length hangs down on both sides of the tabernacle.
This extra fabric covers the sides of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְהָאַמָּ֨ה מִזֶּ֜ה וְהָאַמָּ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ בָּעֹדֵ֔ף בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ יְרִיעֹ֣ת הָאֹ֑הֶל יִהְיֶ֨ה סָר֜וּחַ עַל־ צִדֵּ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה לְכַסֹּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Also make a covering for the tent out of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of fine leather.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a special tent for worship.
Make a covering for the tent.
Use ram skins dyed red for this covering.
Make another covering to go above it.
Use fine leather for the top covering.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵילִ֖ם מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃פ

passages.text: You are to construct upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle is a holy place for worship.
You must make frames for the tabernacle.
Use acacia wood to make the frames.
Make the frames stand upright.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃

passages.text: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
passages.sermon: Each frame is part of the tabernacle.\r\nEach frame must be ten cubits long.\r\nEach frame must be one and a half cubits wide.
passages.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Two tenons must be connected to each other for each frame. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.
passages.sermon:
Each frame must have two tenons.
The two tenons must fit together.
Connect the tenons to each other.
Do this for every frame of the tabernacle.
Make all the frames in this way.
passages.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָד֗וֹת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֑הּ כֵּ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

passages.text: Construct twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle, with forty silver bases under the twenty frames—two bases for each frame, one under each tenon.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a holy tent for worship.
Make twenty frames for the south side of the tabernacle.
Place forty silver bases under these twenty frames.
Put two bases under each frame.
Each base supports one tenon of the frame.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קֶ֔רֶשׁ לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גְבָּה תֵימָֽנָה׃ וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־ כֶ֔סֶף תַּעֲשֶׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: For the second side of the tabernacle, the north side, make twenty frames and forty silver bases—two bases under each frame.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a holy structure for worship.
The tabernacle has two long sides.
The second side is the north side.
Make twenty frames for the north side.
Make forty silver bases for these frames.
Place two silver bases under each frame.
passages.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֖ים קָֽרֶשׁ׃ וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: Make six frames for the rear of the tabernacle, the west side, and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle, coupled together from bottom to top and fitted into a single ring. These will serve as the two corners.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a holy tent for worship.
The west side is the rear of the tabernacle.
Make six frames for the west side of the tabernacle.
Make two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle.
Join the two corner frames together from the bottom up.
Fit the two corner frames into a single ring at the top.
These two frames will form the two corners of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃ וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃ וְיִֽהְי֣וּ תֹֽאֲמִים֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַמִּקְצֹעֹ֖ת יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: So there are to be eight frames and sixteen silver bases—two under each frame.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a holy structure for worship.
The rear of the tabernacle must have eight frames.
These frames must stand upright.
There must be sixteen bases made of silver.
Each frame must have two silver bases under it.
Every frame must rest on its own two bases.
passages.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: You are also to make five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle, five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy tent for worship.
Make five crossbars.
Use acacia wood for these crossbars.
These five crossbars are for the frames on one side of the tabernacle.
Make five more crossbars for the frames on the other side of the tabernacle.
Make five crossbars for the frames at the rear of the tabernacle.
The rear of the tabernacle is on the west side.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בְרִיחִ֖ם עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽד׃ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֗ם לְקַרְשֵׁי֙ צֶ֣לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃

passages.text: The central crossbar in the middle of the frames shall extend from one end to the other.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
The tabernacle had wooden frames.
There was a central crossbar.
This crossbar was in the middle of the frames.
The central crossbar extended from one end of the frames to the other end.
passages.original: וְהַבְּרִ֥יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֖ן בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים מַבְרִ֕חַ מִן־ הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־ הַקָּצֶֽה׃

passages.text: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to build the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy place for worship.
Take the frames for the tabernacle.
Cover the frames with gold.
Make rings for the frames.
Make the rings out of gold.
The rings will hold the crossbars.
Take the crossbars.
Cover the crossbars with gold.
passages.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים תְּצַפֶּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־ טַבְּעֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֶת־ הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on the mountain.
God showed Moses a pattern for the tabernacle.
You must set up the tabernacle.
You must follow the pattern God showed you on the mountain.
passages.original: וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֖ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן כְּמִ֨שְׁפָּט֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרְאֵ֖יתָ בָּהָֽר׃ס

passages.text: Make a veil of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen, with cherubim skillfully worked into it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a veil for the tabernacle.
The veil must use blue yarn.
The veil must use purple yarn.
The veil must use scarlet yarn.
The veil must use finely spun linen.
A skilled craftsman must make the veil.
The craftsman must weave cherubim into the veil.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ פָרֹ֗כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃

passages.text: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood, overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.
passages.sermon:
The tabernacle is a special tent for worship.
God gave Moses a pattern for the tabernacle on the mountain.
Make a veil for the tabernacle.
Hang the veil with gold hooks.
Use four posts made from acacia wood.
Cover the posts with gold.
Set the posts on four silver bases.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ עַל־ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים מְצֻפִּ֣ים זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב עַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־ כָֽסֶף׃

passages.text: And hang the veil from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil. So the veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the tabernacle.
Hang the veil under the clasps.
Place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil.
The veil will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶת־ הַפָּרֹכֶת֮ תַּ֣חַת הַקְּרָסִים֒ וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ מִבֵּ֣ית לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֵ֖ת אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵד֑וּת וְהִבְדִּילָ֤ה הַפָּרֹ֙כֶת֙ לָכֶ֔ם בֵּ֣ין הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּבֵ֖ין קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Put the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
The Most Holy Place is the innermost room of the tabernacle.
The ark of the Testimony is a sacred chest.
Place the mercy seat on top of the ark of the Testimony.
Put the ark with the mercy seat inside the Most Holy Place.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֙ אֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת עַ֖ל אֲר֣וֹן הָעֵדֻ֑ת בְּקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: And place the table outside the veil on the north side of the tabernacle, and put the lampstand opposite the table, on the south side.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a holy tent for worship.
Place the table outside the veil.
The veil separates the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.
Put the table on the north side of the tabernacle.
Place the lampstand opposite the table.
Put the lampstand on the south side of the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַפָּרֹ֔כֶת וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָה֙ נֹ֣כַח הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן עַ֛ל צֶ֥לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהַ֨שֻּׁלְחָ֔ן תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ צֶ֥לַע צָפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: For the entrance to the tent, you are to make a curtain embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and finely spun linen.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was a special tent for worship.
Make a curtain for the entrance to the tent.
Use blue yarn for the curtain.
Use purple yarn for the curtain.
Use scarlet yarn for the curtain.
Use finely spun linen for the curtain.
Embroider the curtain with these materials.
A skilled craftsman must make the curtain.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃

passages.text: Make five posts of acacia wood for the curtain, overlay them with gold hooks, and cast five bronze bases for them.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for building the tabernacle.
Make five posts.
Use acacia wood for the posts.
Cover the posts with gold.
Make gold hooks for the posts.
Make five bases for the posts.
Use bronze to make the bases.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לַמָּסָ֗ךְ חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וְצִפִּיתָ֤ אֹתָם֙ זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְיָצַקְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אַדְנֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס
